title: Core Deployment Data Schema with 30-Day Completeness Validation
description: Extended JSON schema for deployment data validation with strict 30-day completeness requirements. Validates structure and enforces completeness constraints for deployment data covering a continuous 30-day period.

metadata.description: Metadata about the deployment data generation and coverage period

generated_at.description: Timestamp when deployment data was generated (ISO 8601 format)

data_period_start.description: Start of the 30-day analysis period (ISO 8601 format). For completeness validation, the period from data_period_start to data_period_end must be at least 30 days.

data_period_end.description: End of the 30-day analysis period (ISO 8601 format). Must be at least 30 days after data_period_start for completeness validation.

data_sources.description: Data sources used to compile deployment information

current_image.description: Current container image in use (format: registry/image:tag)

last_updated.description: Most recent deployment update timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

metrics.description: Deployment metrics for the 30-day analysis period

total_deployments.description: Total number of deployments in the 30-day analysis period

successful_deployments.description: Number of successful deployments in the 30-day period

failed_deployments.description: Number of failed or scaled-down deployments in the 30-day period

deployment_success_rate.description: Deployment success rate as decimal (0.0 to 1.0) for the 30-day period

last_deployment_timestamp.description: Last deployment timestamp within the 30-day period (ISO 8601 format)

days_since_last_deployment.description: Days since the last deployment (capped at 30+ for periods beyond 30 days)

rollbacks.description: Number of rollback operations in the 30-day period

deployment_frequency_days.description: Average days between deployments calculated over the 30-day period

analysis_period_days.description: Length of the analysis period in days. Must be at least 30 for completeness validation.

replica_history.description: Historical ReplicaSet data covering the 30-day analysis period. For completeness validation, this array should include all deployments within the period with no significant gaps (>7 days).

image.description: Container image used in this ReplicaSet

replicas.description: Number of replicas in this ReplicaSet

days_ago.description: Days since this ReplicaSet was created (0-30 days)

completeness.description: 30-day completeness validation metrics. This section is required for 30-day completeness validation and must pass all checks for the data to be considered complete.

errorMessage.type: Completeness validation section is required but missing. Add a 'completeness' object with period_coverage_days, data_coverage_percent, gaps_detected, and meets_completeness_threshold fields.

period_coverage_days.description: Number of days covered by the deployment data. Must be at least 30 for completeness validation.

errorMessage.minimum: Period coverage is {actual} days but must be at least 30 days for completeness validation. Extend the analysis period from '{data_period_start}' to '{data_period_end}' to ensure at least 30 days of coverage.
errorMessage.type: Period coverage days must be an integer value representing the total days covered by deployment data.

data_coverage_percent.description: Percentage of the 30-day period with deployment data coverage. For completeness validation, this should be 100% or meet the minimum threshold (default 95%).

errorMessage.pattern: Data coverage percentage must be in format 'XX%' (e.g., '95%', '100%'). Current value: '{actual}'. Expected format: '100%', '95%', '87%', etc.
errorMessage.type: Data coverage percent must be a string value like '95%' or '100%'.

gaps_detected.description: Whether data gaps were detected in the 30-day period. For completeness validation, this should be false.

errorMessage.type: Gaps detected must be a boolean value (true/false). Current: '{actual}'.
errorMessage.custom: Data gaps detected in deployment coverage. Check gap_details array for specific missing periods. Critical gaps (>7 days) indicate incomplete deployment history.

gap_details.description: List of gaps detected in the deployment data. For completeness validation, this array should be empty or only contain gaps <3 days. Each gap includes start, end, duration, severity, and affected data types.

errorMessage.type: Gap details must be an array of gap objects, even if empty.
errorMessage.custom: Data gaps detected in coverage period. Review each gap entry for duration (gap_duration_days), severity (critical: >7 days, warning: 3-7 days, info: <3 days), and missing data types. Critical gaps prevent completeness validation.

gap_start_days_ago.description: Days ago when the gap started (relative to data_period_end)

errorMessage.minimum: Gap start days ago cannot be negative. Current: '{actual}'. Expected: 0 or more days ago.
errorMessage.type: Gap start days ago must be an integer relative to the analysis period end.

gap_end_days_ago.description: Days ago when the gap ended (relative to data_period_end)

errorMessage.minimum: Gap end days ago cannot be negative. Current: '{actual}'. Expected: 0 or more days ago.
errorMessage.type: Gap end days ago must be an integer relative to the analysis period end.

gap_duration_days.description: Duration of the gap in days

errorMessage.minimum: Gap duration must be at least 1 day. Current: '{actual}'. Gaps of 0 days should not be recorded.
errorMessage.type: Gap duration must be an integer representing days in the gap.

severity.description: Gap severity level based on duration. Critical: >7 days, Warning: 3-7 days, Info: <3 days

errorMessage.enum: Severity must be one of: 'critical' (>7 days), 'warning' (3-7 days), or 'info' (<3 days). Current: '{actual}'.
errorMessage.type: Severity must be a string value.

missing_data_types.description: Types of data missing during this gap

meets_completeness_threshold.description: Whether the deployment data meets the minimum completeness threshold (default: 95% coverage for 30-day period). For completeness validation, this should be true.

errorMessage.type: Completeness threshold must be a boolean value (true/false). Current: '{actual}'.
errorMessage.custom: Completeness threshold not met. Coverage: {data_coverage_percent} (required: {completeness_threshold_percent}). Action: Extend data collection period, fill missing deployment data, or adjust threshold if appropriate.

completeness_threshold_percent.description: Minimum completeness threshold required for 30-day validation. Default is 95%, but can be set to 100% for strict validation.

errorMessage.pattern: Completeness threshold must be in format 'XX%' (e.g., '95%', '100%'). Current: '{actual}'. Expected format: percentage string with % symbol.
errorMessage.type: Completeness threshold must be a string percentage value.

minimum_deployment_days.description: Minimum number of deployment days required in the 30-day period. Default is 1, but can be increased for stricter validation.

errorMessage.minimum: Minimum deployment days cannot be negative. Current: '{actual}'. Expected: 0 or more days.
errorMessage.type: Minimum deployment days must be an integer value.

actual_deployment_days.description: Actual number of distinct days with deployments in the 30-day period

errorMessage.minimum: Actual deployment days cannot be negative. Current: '{actual}'. Expected: 0 or more days with deployment activity.
errorMessage.type: Actual deployment days must be an integer count of days with deployments.

deployment_days_threshold_met.description: Whether the minimum deployment days threshold is met. For completeness validation, this should be true.

errorMessage.type: Deployment days threshold must be a boolean value (true/false). Current: '{actual}'.
errorMessage.custom: Deployment days threshold not met. Actual: {actual_deployment_days} days (required: {minimum_deployment_days} days). Action: Verify deployment activity in the analysis period or adjust minimum_deployment_days threshold if appropriate.

pod_health.description: Current pod health and runtime statistics

total_restarts.description: Total container restarts across all pods

storage.description: Storage information for PVCs and volumes

summary.description: Summary statistics for the 30-day analysis period

overall_health_status.description: Overall service health status based on 30-day deployment data

data_coverage.description: Percentage of data coverage over the 30-day period (e.g., '100%')

gaps_detected.description: Whether data gaps were detected in the 30-day period

largest_gap_days.description: Size of the largest gap in days within the 30-day period

recommendation.description: Operational recommendation based on 30-day deployment data analysis

minimum_period_days.description: Minimum required analysis period in days for completeness validation

strict_coverage_threshold.description: Strict coverage percentage threshold (no gaps allowed)

critical_gap_days.description: Gap duration in days that triggers critical severity

warning_gap_days.description: Gap duration in days that triggers warning severity

minimum_deployment_events.description: Minimum number of deployment events required

minimum_deployment_days.description: Minimum number of distinct days with deployments

gap_details.description: When completeness threshold is not met, gap_details must contain at least one entry explaining the failure
